def count_ones_in_range(n, l, r):
    def generate_sequence(n):
        sequence = []
        while n > 0:
            sequence.append(n % 2)
            n //= 2
        return sequence[::-1]

    def count_ones(sequence, l, r):
        return sum(sequence[l-1:r])

    sequence = generate_sequence(n)
    count = count_ones(sequence, l, r)
    print(count)
